requirements.summary: Separate playback from catalog writes: Keep the domain as a modular application; split only the playback authorization path and heavy processing workloads.
requirements.remainingWork: Catalog reads and cache policy must remain compatible. This is a proposed design choice, not evidence of production scalability. Source decision status is preserved in the original factory; this new obligation records outstanding implementation/review only.

requirements.summary: Bounded media revocation: Use 15-second metadata TTL, event invalidation, CDN purge and grants lasting at most 60 seconds. Fail closed for unknown authority.

requirements.summary: Validate workload, cost and recovery: Measure mixed bitrate workloads, hot-key storms, origin egress, cache outages and restore drills before selecting production capacity.
requirements.remainingWork: No production capacity, budget or recovery guarantee is approved by this example. Source decision status is preserved in the original factory; this new obligation records outstanding implementation/review only.
